manifest.camera_intrinsics: square pixels fx=fy=0.96*width; centered principal point; clip .012 to 4 m
manifest.control: constant 0.025 float32 per actuator, no external generalized or body force
manifest.initial: native qpos0, zero velocity/activation and time
manifest.visuals: native opaque geoms only; source plane half extents; 12-sector round mesh; sites omitted

ray_query.capture_scope: successful RGB-requested captures, not ray count or visible shadow pixel count
ray_query.buffer_scope: logical AS and scratch buffer bytes; actual VkDeviceMemory allocation telemetry is separate
ray_query.update_scope: one GPU TLAS build or update per acquired matrix publication, shared across its camera draws
ray_query.upload_scope: instance_upload_bytes counts host TLAS-instance uploads; shared instance records are generated on the GPU
ray_query.snapshot: last live query, retained after close; final allocation teardown is reported by resident telemetry
ray_query.instance_source: Vulkan compute over the shared device matrix buffer
